children: KKR & Co Inc (NYSE:KKR) is monetizing assets—raising $3.3B and booking ~$2B gains—while scaling private credit (YTD originations >$80B), expanding Europe and Asia deals, entering JVs and minority stakes, and positioning for higher rates and demand for productivity and energy upgrades.
Previous Week Recap
KKR Raises $3.3B, $2B Gains
: KKR & Co. raised $3.3 billion from an asset sale and recognized about $2 billion in gains on the transaction.
Private Credit Opportunity, $7.6T Capex
: KKR says private investment-grade lending is a big opportunity, citing insurance and pension capital. Cited $7.6T hyperscaler capex over five years and $80B+ originated/placed YTD, up 104%.
Private IG Originations Top $80B
: KKR & Co Inc (KKR) says private investment-grade originations year-to-date topped $80 billion, reflecting the firm’s origination activity in that asset class this year.
€528M 49% JV With Realty Income
: KKR will invest about €528M for 49% of a euro JV with Realty Income to own 54 net‑lease properties (140 units) across Spain, Ireland, Poland and the Netherlands; deal closes Sept 30, 2026.
Asia Private Credit Growth Outlook
: KKR says Asia is a long‑term growth market for private credit, citing fragmentation, entry barriers and need for local teams; estimates about $800 billion needed to reach Europe‑level penetration.
KKR-Owned Flora Food Group Auction
: Sky News reports that KKR & Co Inc (KKR), identified as the owner of Flora Food Group, is set to begin a €7 billion auction process for Flora Food Group.
KKR In Keeps Bayer LARC Stake
: KKR joined Apollo as a minority investor in a €3 billion deal funding Bayer’s LARC unit, taking an equity stake while Bayer keeps majority ownership and operational control.
Datavant Minority Stake Purchase
: KKR, via its Strategic Investments Group, will join Neuberger and New Mountain Capital to buy a significant minority stake in healthcare data platform Datavant; deal expected to close Q4 2026.
Tighter Credit, Productivity Spending Rise
: KKR expects tighter credit to boost demand for productivity upgrades, employee retraining, energy and grid projects, and shifts from capital-heavy to capital-light models—areas KKR plans to target.
Higher U.S. Treasury Forecast, Fed Rates
: KKR raised its long-end U.S. Treasury yield forecast and now sees the Fed holding benchmark rates higher than earlier projected, citing Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s concerns about persistent inflation.
